viewing_check: Check rim ruffles and base ring for chips, nibbles and flea bites; confirm bowl size (~24cm), hold up to light for cracks; confirm colour is deep amethyst/black (not marigold) and iridescence is intact, not worn; look for repairs. Photograph the underside.
